title: Bounded-fanin tree compilation
statement: Let $c$ be a Boolean circuit tree on $n$ variables whose maximum fanin is at most $2$. There exists an equivalent acyclic Boolean circuit with gates of fanin at most $2$, with no repeated input to a gate and exactly one input to each NOT gate, such that every non-input vertex is read by at most one gate and the circuit size is at most $n+\mathrm{size}(c)$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a Boolean circuit tree on $n$ variables
The maximum fanin of $c$ is at most $2$
